# Competency questions — research methodology & practice family
*Generated by concept-family-explorer run 2026-06-15. Seeds: online research methodology, applied research, algorithmic research, research notes, research annotations & data storage, research skills. Each CQ must resolve to a HAVE or researched-this-run node for coverage saturation.*

1. **CQ-1 (note capture / PKM):** How do I build a note-taking / personal-knowledge-management system (Zettelkasten, literature vs permanent notes, linked notes, progressive summarization) to capture and synthesize a large body of research over time?
2. **CQ-2 (research data management):** How do I organize, document, and store research/analysis datasets so they are Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) — data management plans, metadata standards, repositories, codebooks/data dictionaries, persistent dataset IDs?
3. **CQ-3 (annotation / labeling):** How do I design a labeling/annotation effort for an ML or eval dataset — annotation guidelines, inter-annotator agreement (Cohen/Krippendorff), active learning, LLM-assisted labeling, and tooling?
4. **CQ-4 (qualitative coding):** How do I code and thematically analyze qualitative data (interviews, support cases, meeting notes) using grounded theory / thematic analysis, and when can an LLM assist the coding?
5. **CQ-5 (AI research tools):** Which AI-assisted literature-review tools (Elicit, Consensus, Undermind, scite) fit which research job, and how do I combine them with the hub's firecrawl/exa deep-research workflows?
6. **CQ-6 (evidence rigor):** How do I run a systematic review (PRISMA search → screening → extraction) and grade evidence (GRADE), and when is that warranted over an ad-hoc deep-research synthesis?
7. **CQ-7 (research integrity):** How do I judge whether a study is trustworthy — preregistration, replication, p-hacking/HARKing, open data/code — and avoid those pitfalls in my own analysis?
8. **CQ-8 (provenance):** How do I track the provenance and lineage of sources and claims through an AI-assisted research pipeline so a synthesis is auditable and reproducible?
9. **CQ-9 (citation / referencing):** How do I manage citations and references (Zotero/BibTeX), choose a citation style, and use persistent identifiers (DOI/ORCID)?
10. **CQ-10 (experimental design & reproducibility):** How do I design a sound experiment / A-B test with adequate statistical power and valid causal inference, and make the analysis reproducible (environment capture, notebooks, IMRaD reporting)?
